name: api-website
description: Commercial-grade RESTful API service platform: official website + API gateway + business services + admin

scripts.db:migrate: bash -c 'set -a && source .env && set +a && pnpm --filter @api-website/db exec prisma migrate deploy'
scripts.db:seed: bash -c 'set -a && source .env && set +a && pnpm --filter @api-website/db exec prisma db seed'
scripts.db:setup: pnpm prisma:generate && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
